_comment: Provenance for every third-party file in extension/lib/. extension/build.sh pins
the same SHA-256 values and refuses to package a file that does not match, so a
compromised CDN cannot swap a bundle silently. This file records where each one
came from and how to reproduce it, which build.sh alone does not say.
AMO review requires the pre-minification source for anything minified in a
submitted package; 'reproduce' below is that answer for each file.
Verify everything at once with: npm run test:vendor-manifest

files.role: Legacy HLS-to-MP4 transmuxer. Fallback engine since the Mediabunny default; upstream has had no commit since 2024-10-11.
Default HLS-to-MP4 transmuxer, running WebCodecs inside a module Worker.
MPL-2.0 license text, required to ship alongside the bundle.
